title: A general Mayer-Vietoris sequence in algebraic $K$-theory
summary: This paper investigates the Mayer-Vietoris sequence for the Milnor square. While such sequences often involve elusive intermediate terms, we provide an explicit characterization of the key group $X$ in a new, more general variant of the sequence. By identifying $X$ as a categorical pullback, we provide a full, constructive proof of the modified Mayer-Vietoris sequence. Furthermore, we show that $X$ fits into a structural exact sequence involving the relative $K$-groups $K_{*}(A, B, I)$.
